title: Identification of Novel Inhibitors Targeting SGK1 via Ensemble-Based Virtual Screening Method, Biological Evaluation and Molecular Dynamics Simulation.
authors: Zhang, Hui; Shen, Chen; Zhang, Hong-Rui; Qi, Hua-Zhao; Hu, Mei-Ling; Luo, Qing-Qing
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦SGK1激酶小分子抑制剂发现，核心对象为蛋白-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Serum and glucocorticoid-regulated kinase 1 (SGK1), as a serine threonine protein kinase of the AGC family, regulates different enzymes, transcription factors, ion channels, transporters, and cell proliferation and apoptosis. Inhibition of SGK1 is considered as a valuable approach for the treatment of various metabolic diseases. In this investigation, virtual screening methods, including pharmacophore models, Bayesian classifiers, and molecular docking, were combined to discover novel inhibitors of SGK1 from the database with 29,158 compounds. Then, the screened compounds were subjected to ADME/T, PAINS and drug-likeness analysis. Finally, 28 compounds with potential inhibition activity against SGK1 were selected for biological evaluation. The kinase inhibition activity test revealed that among these 28 hits, hit15 exhibited the highest inhibition activity against SGK1, which gave 44.79% inhibition rate at the concentration of 10 microM. In order to further investigate the interaction mechanism of hit15 and SGK1 at simulated physiological conditions, a molecular dynamics simulation was performed. The molecular dynamics simulation demonstrated that hit15 could bind to the active site of SGK1 and form stable interactions with key residues, such as Tyr178, ILE179, and VAL112. The binding free energy of the SGK1-hit15 was -48.90 kJ mol(-1). Therefore, the identified hit15 with novel scaffold may be a promising lead compound for development of new SGK1 inhibitors for various diseases treatment.
abstract_zh: 血清和糖皮质激素调节激酶1（SGK1）作为AGC家族的丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶，调控多种酶、转录因子、离子通道、转运体以及细胞增殖与凋亡。抑制SGK1被认为是治疗多种代谢疾病的有效策略。在本研究中，结合药效团模型、贝叶斯分类器和分子对接等虚拟筛选方法，从包含29,158个化合物的数据库中寻找新型SGK1抑制剂。随后，对筛选出的化合物进行ADME/T、PAINS及类药性分析。最终，选出28个具有潜在SGK1抑制活性的化合物进行生物学评价。激酶抑制活性测试显示，在这28个命中化合物中，hit15对SGK1表现出最高的抑制活性，在10微摩尔浓度下抑制率为44.79%。为进一步探究hit15与SGK1在模拟生理条件下的相互作用机制，进行了分子动力学模拟。分子动力学模拟表明，hit15能结合至SGK1的活性位点，并与关键残基如Tyr178、ILE179和VAL112形成稳定相互作用。SGK1-hit15的结合自由能为-48.90 kJ mol(-1)。因此，具有新型骨架的hit15可能成为开发针对多种疾病治疗的新型SGK1抑制剂的有前景的先导化合物。
